I am an old man with no schooling, farming this small beans plot of one quarter hectare in the North West. Beans do not need much chemical fertilizer because they fix their own nitrogen in the soil, so I will save my money and not buy NPK or urea for this plot. I will use my own seed kept from last harvest like I always do, and put a little manure from my animals to help the soil. My sons and I will weed by hand, and I may call one or two neighbors for a day when the weeding is heavy.
